title: Quarterly flight plan: Hosted API + Model Catalog harmonization
creator: Aisha Khan
description: High-level quarterly plan to align Hosted API feature rollouts with model catalog curation and canary schedules. Objective: reduce customer-facing regression risk while improving throughput/cost efficiency across our hosted endpoints. Deliverables include a phased model onboarding calendar, canary windows for each major model variant, an evaluation matrix (quality + perf), and a cross-team ops runbook for rollback and fallback routing policies.
acceptance_criteria: Published quarterly calendar linking Hosted API feature milestones to model onboarding and deprecation dates
Canary plan with windows and automated rollback triggers documented and validated in staging
Evaluation matrix completed for top 8 models (perf, cost, quality) with recommended default variants
Console dashboards updated with route-level cost/latency guardrails for the planned rollouts
